viscosity_model: Artificial viscosity alpha 0.01; not a validated wall-resolved resistance setup
propulsion: Assumed world-fixed 30 N model force at CG, no resolved propeller or actuator disk
convergence: No systematic space/time convergence study of this completed strong-wave case.

variable_resolution.time_step_policy: JSphVResDriver.h SynchTimeStep uses the minimum predicted dt of all zones; no local subcycling in this driver.
variable_resolution.suggested_followup: Retain 0.05 m far-field initially and test a body-tracking 0.025 m refinement region; compare incident waves, forces and motions. Not run or validated.
variable_resolution.notes: VRes uses coupled subdomains and buffer reconstruction. It should not be described as simply inserting a few denser particles. Existing single-resolution particle-ID renderer needs adaptation to changing IDs and particle volumes.
